body:
Find and fix sustained memory growth in the running app.

- Reproduce the growth with repeatable steps: leave the app open, move between pages, and exercise live task and Strategy updates; record any more specific trigger found.
- Measure before and after to distinguish a real leak from a bounded cache, and name what retains the memory.
- Fix the root cause and release or bound anything intentionally retained, such as listeners, subscriptions, event history or task updates.
- Add a regression test for the identified path where practical; otherwise record the manual reproduction and before/after measurements.
- Keep behavior and public routes unchanged. If profiling finds independent leaks, fix the measured one here and file follow-ups rather than widening this task.

No feature or milestone: this is cross-cutting maintenance. Left out: speculative allocation or render optimizations, and a claim to fix every independent leak in one pass.
title: Fix app memory leaks
